title: Question registry file
description: Questions of one Domain, filed in questions/<domain>.json. The file name must equal the Domain of the main (highest absolute weight) Characteristic of every Question in it.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier, at most 7 words. Used by routes (routes[].add).

title.description: The text shown to the user, at most 19 words, concrete and about one topic. An agreement statement or a frequency question, matching 'answer'.

details.description: Optional extra help shown under the title (examples, clarification), at most 59 words.

type.description: Stage of the Question. discovery: generic, queued at session start. exploration: details a Characteristic after a route. differentiation: separates similar Characteristics. balancing: phrased in the opposite direction (negative weight) to catch acquiescence.

answer.description: Answer scale. agreement: -1 (strongly disagree) to 1 (strongly agree). frequency: 0 (never) to 1 (always), centred when scored.

characteristics.description: Characteristics this Question adds evidence to. The one with the highest absolute weight is the main Characteristic and defines the Domain file.

weight.description: How strongly and in which direction the answer counts: positive when agreeing shows the Characteristic, negative when agreeing shows the opposite; larger absolute value means stronger evidence. Never 0.

routes.description: Optional rules that add other Questions to the queue after this one is answered with a value. Routes only add; they never remove or skip. The route graph must have no cycles.

when.description: gte matches when the answer is greater than or equal to the threshold, lte when it is less than or equal.

threshold.description: Value compared with the stored answer; must be one of the values of the answer's 5-point scale (agreement -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1; frequency 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1).

add.description: Id of the Question added to the queue when the route matches.

source.description: Plain-text origin of the Question (reference or authoring note), so reviewers can check it.
